patterns.note: Asymmetrical hero section with a large, playful graphic title on the left and a dynamic, full-bleed image of people on the right, creating an energetic first impression.

Prominent use of custom, 3D-effect display typography for the main brand name ('FEASTIE') and a layered, sticker-like graphic font for the event type ('SIP & SNACK FESTIVAL'), contrasting with clean, modern sans-serifs for body text and details.

A high-contrast, vibrant color palette featuring deep purples, bright greens, hot pinks, and punchy oranges, used in large blocks and graphic elements to define sections and highlight calls to action.
No scroll-triggered motion, parallax, or element reveals are observed in the provided scroll sequence; content appears statically as the user scrolls down the page.

Content sections are clearly delineated by distinct background colors and large, illustrative graphic elements, such as the wavy pink separator in the hero and the light green background for the ticket information.

technique_notes: To rebuild the visual style, use custom SVG or Lottie animations for the main 'FEASTIE' and 'SIP & SNACK FESTIVAL' titles to achieve their unique 3D and layered graphic effects. Employ a grid system for content blocks like vendor listings and sponsor logos, ensuring consistent spacing. Utilize a vibrant, high-contrast color palette to define distinct sections and draw attention to key information and calls to action. For motion, the site relies on static presentation; no scroll-triggered animations are observed, so content simply scrolls into view naturally.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, graphic display headings (~6x body) with a playful, bold character, complemented by clear, legible sans-serifs for subheadings and body text.
design_tokens.radius: Rounded corners are consistently applied to cards, buttons, and input fields, contributing to a soft and approachable feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced density with airy sections, particularly in the hero, transitioning to a more structured grid for content listings like vendors and sponsors.

standout: This site's design is distinctive for its bold, graphic-heavy approach, particularly the custom 3D typography and layered, sticker-like elements that give it a unique, playful personality. The vibrant, high-contrast color palette further enhances this energetic and memorable aesthetic, making it feel less like a generic template and more like a bespoke brand experience.
